rv.q: A visually wondrous show – but still more for adults than for children.
Their performance is all that works best here: Shakespeare made easy but carefully layered and effortlessly moving too.
The Unicorn's first major co-production with the Royal Shakespeare Company is a breathtaking triumph.
Beautifully designed and highly accessible, it offers plenty to enjoy – particularly for those encountering Shakespeare for the first time
This is a wonderful production to introduce a child to the world of Shakespeare.

cn.t: This RSC-Unicorn co-production delivers an accessible, spirited adaptation that captivates young audiences without dumbing down Shakespeare's language. Critics praise its inventive captioning, striking video design, and playful energy across a brisk 90 minutes.
